content.summary: Local television broadcasting and media company Gray Television (NYSE:GTN) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 21.2% year on year to $749 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $774.5 million was less impressive, coming in 4.8% below analysts’ estimates.
